title: A Test on Adverse Selection of Farmers in Crop Insurance: Results from Inner Mongolia in China
abstract: Adverse selection is an operating risk of crop insurance. Based on survey data on crop insurance collected by questionnaires in Inner Mongolia, China, the paper uses non-parametric analysis and econometric models to estimate the relationship between conditions for crop production and farmers' insurance decision in order to test the existence of farmers' adverse selection. The results show farmers' adverse selection does exist, but settling a claim by negotiation and premium subsidy from governments at all levels can defuse farmers' adverse selection under the current system of crop insurance. Risk regionalization, heterogeneous insurance contract and product innovation may decrease adverse selection to some extent.
abstract_zh: 逆向选择是作物保险的一项经营风险。基于在中国内蒙古通过问卷调查收集的作物保险调查数据，本文运用非参数分析和计量经济模型，估计作物生产条件与农民投保决策之间的关系，以检验农民逆向选择是否存在。结果表明，农民逆向选择确实存在，但在现行作物保险制度下，通过协商理赔以及各级政府的保费补贴，可以在一定程度上化解农民的逆向选择。风险区划、保险合同的异质化以及产品创新，可能在一定程度上降低逆向选择。

Smooth Coefficient Models with Endogenous Environmental Variables
abstract: We develop a three-step, oracle-efficient estimator for a structural semiparametric smooth coefficient model with endogenous variables in the nonparametric part of the model. We use a control function approach, combined with both series and kernel estimators to obtain consistent and asymptotically normal estimators of the functions and their partial derivatives. We develop a residual-based test statistic for testing endogeneity, and demonstrate the finite sample performance of our estimators, as well as our test, via Monte Carlo simulations. Finally, we develop an application of our estimator to the relationship between public benefits and private savings.
abstract_zh: 我们针对一种结构性半参数平滑系数模型开发了一种三步式、具有预言机效率（oracle-efficient）的估计量，该模型在非参数部分包含内生变量。我们采用控制函数方法，结合级数估计量与核估计量，以获得函数及其偏导数的一致且渐近正态的估计量。我们开发了一种基于残差的检验统计量，用于检验内生性，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟展示了我们的估计量及检验在有限样本中的表现。最后，我们将该估计量应用于公共福利与私人储蓄之间的关系。

An Empirical Analysis of the Effect of Crop Insurance on Farmers' Income: Results from Inner Mongolia in China
abstract:
The purpose of this paper is to assess the effect of crop insurance on farmer income in Inner Mongolia, China
We use a survey of farmers in Inner Mongolia, China, with difference-in-difference, propensity score matching, and hybrid propensity score matching difference-in-difference treatment effect estimators to assess the effectiveness of crop insurance on farmer income.
The empirical results show that crop insurance does not significantly affect farmer income under the current policy of “low-premium, wide-coverage, low-guarantee and low-indemnity.”
A possible limitation of this study is that the data includes only one geographic area, Inner Mongolia, China, and so results may not generalize to other regions of China.
This research provides empirical estimates of the impact of crop insurance on farm household income. Given the results, we speculate that a number of specific changes to the crop insurance program might increase its positive impacts.
We believe this is the ﬁrst study to use individual farm household level survey data to evaluate the impact of crop insurance on farmer income in China.
abstract_zh:
本文旨在评估作物保险对中国内蒙古农民收入的影响。
我们利用对中国内蒙古农民的调查数据，采用双重差分、倾向得分匹配以及混合倾向得分匹配双重差分处理效应估计量，以评估作物保险对农民收入的有效性。
实证结果表明，在“低保费、广覆盖、低保障、低赔付”的现行政策下，作物保险对农民收入并无显著影响。
本研究可能存在的局限在于，数据仅涵盖中国内蒙古一个地理区域，因此结果未必能推广到中国其他地区。
本研究为作物保险对农户收入的影响提供了实证估计。鉴于这些结果，我们推测对作物保险计划进行若干具体调整，或许能增强其正面影响。
我们认为，这是首个利用农户个体层面调查数据评估作物保险对中国农民收入影响的研究。

Quantifying the Effects of Underground Natural Gas Storage on Nearby Residents
abstract: We estimate the potential negative effects of underground natural gas storage on local residents using hedonic regression and a sample of Indiana properties transacted between 2004 and 2013. We find that underground natural gas storage activities significantly reduce property values. Property values increase by about 10 percent at a distance of 1 kilometer from a storage field. Each additional storage well and observation well located near a property reduces the property's value by about 0.43 percent and 2.64 percent, respectively. Our research sheds new light on a previously unexplored aspect of natural gas resource activities.
abstract_zh: 我们利用享乐回归法及2004年至2013年间在印第安纳州成交的房产样本，估计地下天然气储存对当地居民的潜在负面影响。我们发现，地下天然气储存活动会显著降低房产价值。距离储气田1公里处的房产价值约上升10%。靠近房产的每增加一口储气井，房产价值降低约0.43%；每增加一口观测井，房产价值降低约2.64%。我们的研究为天然气资源开发活动中一个此前未被探讨的方面提供了新的启示。

Voluntary Pollution Abatement and Regulation
abstract: We consider private provision of an environmental public good and the link between voluntary pollution-abatement markets and the optimal level of mandatory environmental regulation. We show that voluntary abatement markets react to the level of mandatory abatement imposed and that an optimal regulatory policy must account for that reaction. We consider several assumptions about consumer behavior and find that the voluntary market's reaction to regulation depends on the motivating behavior of consumers. Whether the optimal level of mandatory abatement is higher than the level provided by traditional settings depends on the direction and magnitude of the voluntary market's reaction to changes in mandatory abatement.
abstract_zh: 我们考察环境公共物品的私人供给，以及自愿减排市场与强制性环境监管最优水平之间的联系。我们证明，自愿减排市场会对所施加的强制性减排水平作出反应，而最优监管政策必须考虑这种反应。我们考虑了关于消费者行为的若干假设，发现自愿市场对监管的反应取决于消费者的动机行为。强制性减排的最优水平是否高于传统设定下所提供的水平，取决于自愿市场对强制性减排变化作出反应的方向和幅度。
